title: kg_sync.PLAIN_ROOT_NAME copies kbsettings' plain-name pattern, so a name layered accepts but the copy skips drops that root's gate_checks silently
goal: kg_sync.gate_check_entries decides a kb directory name is plain by one pattern, kbsettings.PLAIN_NAME, which kbsettings.layered also uses for a kb root name; kg_sync keeps no copy of it
